Answer: D
Reason: The initial radiograph (Figure 1) shows a large opacity/mass in the right lower lung zone, likely associated with pleural effusion or atelectasis. In the follow-up radiograph (Figure 4), this initial mass has completely resolved, but new pulmonary nodules are now visible in the right mid-lung field, indicating disease progression or metastasis despite the resolution of the primary lesion.
